license_note: LongCat-2.5-Preview is served through the LongCat API Platform under the LongCat AI Platform Terms of Use, which form part of the LongCat Terms of Use (version 3.1, updated 2026-06-30). Those terms reserve all rights in the models, including model weights and parameters, to the operator, prohibit reverse engineering the platform's models and training or fine-tuning competing models on outputs, and license no weights for self-operation. The LongCat-2.0 MIT weights license covers the separate LongCat-2.0 release and does not extend to this preview.

license_evidence.scope: Access to LongCat-2.5-Preview through the LongCat API Platform under the LongCat AI Platform Terms of Use and the LongCat Terms of Use

access_boundary: This record represents the LongCat-2.5-Preview release announced September 25, 2026 and served through the LongCat API Platform under the model name LongCat-2.5-Preview. The open-weight LongCat-2.0 release, the retired LongCat-2.0-Preview beta, earlier LongCat-Flash models, the longcat.chat consumer chat product, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: The platform documents the model name, the 1M-token context with 128K output, image and video input, OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and a dated changelog entry
The governing platform terms and the parent terms of use are published with a version number and an update date
tradeoffs: No weights, repository, or model card are published for this preview, so self-operation is unavailable even though the LongCat-2.0 release is open
The Preview name carries no stated retention posture, and the platform's change log records retiring six earlier LongCat models on May 29, 2026
